My dear [Lady Meath](/person/985)

[Annie Cazenove](/person/274) and I agree that you would be greatly interested in Miss [Margaretta Scott](/person/2435)'s work.

She is an American Churchwoman hard at work among the girls of superior class in Liberia

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

Annie Cazenove is as bright and energetic as ever
